method: Built-in OpenAI ImageGen, four project-owned room palette references and one independent collectible brief
provider_revision: Built-in model revision and seed were not exposed.
cleanup: One native sheet per brief. Quadrant isolation, connected matte cleanup, antialiased edge preservation, Lanczos resampling and twelve-pixel atlas cell padding with prepare_atlases.py.

playroom.prompt: Create a square 2 by 2 source sheet with exactly four individually isolated, complete foreground object clusters on real transparent alpha. Each quadrant is one cluster. Leave at least 7% empty padding on all four sides of each cell, especially at the midlines. No cluster may touch another. Each cluster has a single horizontal support baseline with its whole base visible. No extraneous marks in the alpha, big cast shadows, scene backdrop, floors, roads, vehicles, text, numbers, or characters. These assets are world-anchored decorative landmarks seen at a low camera height from a toy-size kart. Frame them in a gentle mostly-frontal three-quarter view. Match only the provided Mermaid Roshan room palette, soft storybook painted finish, materials, trims and proportions. Strong unique outer silhouette, simple two-tone big forms and neat miniature detail, soft edges and hand-painted surfaces. Avoid hyperreal detail and thick black outlines. A consistent shared light from upper left. Fill each cell with its own subject at similar scale. Pearl Castle Playroom. Use lavender masonry, soft carved gold shells, rosy carpets, teal windows and powder-blue wood. Top left: large colorful wooden building-block castle with three asymmetric turret towers and broad solid toy base. Top right: low rosy reading alcove with a draped canopy, book stacks and oversized teal floor cushions on a platform. Bottom left: two peaked blue-and-gold star-play tents, cloth pennants and a crescent finial on a single wooden platform. Bottom right: a chunky toy clock and train station, one stationary toy engine with big painted wheels and a little clock tower set on one low platform. Each silhouette clearly different.

pickups.prompt: Make a square source sprite sheet, strictly four independent transparent-alpha cells separated by broad gutters. No writing, faces, characters, stars, sparkle particles outside forms, arrows, cast shadows, floor, frame around the sheet, or border. These are four extremely clear collectible illustrations for the hand-painted 2D storybook Mermaid Roshan game. A kart collects the first two; instantly distinct at tiny screen size. Use soft storybook paint with clearly separated bold value blocks, readable silhouette, upper left lighting. Top left only: an almost square bold teal-and-indigo sea glass capsule with a raised ivory scallop shell emblem and warm gold clasp at center, crisp dark plum contour, slightly angled three-quarter front, buoyant and magical. Top right only: one large fully round warm ivory treasure pearl, lit creamy yellow, clearly round with no surrounding shell, small gold rim around bottom, dark amber edge for contrast. Bottom left only: subdued flat empty round teal-and-purple rim, an unlit socket facing directly upward as viewed from 30 degrees, transparent central opening. Bottom right only: the same ring from the same view glowing in turquoise with gold rim, open center.
